Smt. Savita D/o Shri Shambhu Singh W/o Lokesh Gehlot,
 Aged About 37 Years, B/c Sen R/o Innnside Ramanuj
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mahesh Khyani For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.K. Mehar, PP
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 16/05/2023

This instant criminal misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of FIR No.165/2015 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Jodhpur East and all consequential proceedings for offences under Sections 498-A and 406 of IPC on the basis of compromise entered between the parties.
Counsel for the parties submit that the petitioner and respondent No.2/complainant are husband and wife.

They have entered into a compromise in the spirit of Lok Adalat and settled their dispute amicably, therefore, the criminal proceedings offence under Section 498-A IPC may be quashed on the basis of compromise.

(2 of 2) [CRLMP-2004/2023] Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioner and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in which it has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the criminal proceedings for offence under Section 498-A IPC are liable to be quashed.
